scoring.zh: 每项只判是/否，部分满足即否。组得分 = 组权重 ×（通过项/组内项数），总分 = 各组之和（满分 100）。评委须与求解模型不同家族，求解者自述（playback-check.md）不作证据。组级门槛只让对应组/项记 0；整题门槛仅 GATE0 与 GATE-CHEAT。由 tests/checks.py 判定的项不再交给评委。

gates.zh: output/ 中 presentation.pptx、slides.pdf、script.md、evidence-index.csv、playback-check.md 齐全且 PPTX 可被 python-pptx 读取。
gates.verify: 文件存在 + python-pptx 打开
gates.fail_effect: 整题验收失败，所有项记否

gates.zh: 未联网、未访问隐藏文件、未使用 input/ 以外的数据源。
gates.fail_effect: 整题验收失败（连续分照常报告）

gates.zh: presentation.pptx 在 Windows 桌面版 PowerPoint 16.x 中以 Presentations.Open(ReadOnly) 与 Open(ReadWrite) 均无错误、无修复提示打开（不使用 OpenAndRepair）。
gates.verify: Windows PowerPoint COM 动态检查（同 R3 windows_dynamic 协议，去掉媒体部分）

gates.zh: 所有原生图表 ChartData.Activate() 成功。

G3.zh: 材料覆盖与口径（含隐藏考点）

items.criterion_zh: 开场页提出题面问题（规模/转折时点/重症与死亡风险/证据强度与对州可用结论），最后一页对每一部分给出直接回答。
items.criterion_en: Opening states the multi-part question; last slide answers each part directly.

items.criterion_zh: 叙事围绕问题推进（规模→曲线与转折→严重程度→证据强度→对州的规划含义），不出现与主问题无关的措施/机构罗列页（≥2 页纯罗列即否）。
items.criterion_en: Narrative follows the question (size→curve/turn→severity→strength of evidence→state planning); no ≥2 slides of off-question listing of measures/agencies.

items.criterion_zh: 每页标题是可由该页证据支持的论断句（非“Background”“Results”类名词标题），全部页面满足。
items.criterion_en: Every slide title is a claim supported by that slide (no topic-label titles).

items.criterion_zh: 转折归因区分“与措施时间上同步/多源数据支持下降真实”与“由某措施导致”；把“避免数十万例”表述为基于省际粗罹患率比较的估计；全篇（含末页）不把转折全部归功于单一措施。
items.criterion_en: Attribution separates timing/multi-source evidence that the decline is real from causation by a specific measure; 'hundreds of thousands averted' framed as an estimate from cross-province crude attack rates; never credits the turn wholly to one measure.
items.verify: 全文检索 caused/because of/thanks to 等；对照 answer-key T10–T12

items.criterion_zh: 为听众解释至少三个必要术语（实验室确诊/临床诊断病例、粗病死率 CFR、按发病日期/报告日期的流行曲线），且解释与材料一致。
items.criterion_en: Explains ≥3 necessary terms (lab-confirmed vs clinically diagnosed, crude CFR, onset- vs report-date epi curve) consistently with the materials.

items.criterion_zh: 讲稿逐页时长相加在 12–15 分钟内；讲稿总词数 W 与声明总时长 T（分钟）满足 0.75×W/160 ≤ T ≤ 1.25×W/130（即隐含语速约 104–213 词/分钟）。
items.criterion_en: Script per-slide durations sum to 12–15 min; total word count W and declared total T (min) satisfy 0.75×W/160 ≤ T ≤ 1.25×W/130 (implied rate ≈104–213 wpm).

items.criterion_zh: 对州的规划含义至少 3 条，每条绑定材料中的具体证据（含文件与页码，如家庭聚集、密接追踪产出、医护感染、发病至确诊时间），不是泛泛口号。
items.criterion_en: ≥3 state-planning implications, each tied to specific evidence with file+page (e.g. household clusters, contact-tracing yield, HCW infections, onset-to-confirmation time).

items.criterion_zh: 结论页把证据分为“已由数据支持 / 有条件成立 / 材料不能回答”三类并各给至少一例。
items.criterion_en: Conclusion sorts claims into supported / conditional / not answerable by the materials, ≥1 example each.

items.criterion_zh: 没有任何一页超过 6 条要点。
items.criterion_en: No slide has more than 6 bullets.
items.verify: checks.py cdc_layout.bullets_per_slide: per slide, non-empty paragraphs of body/object placeholders (unless buNone) plus paragraphs with explicit bullets in other text shapes; captions/source lines and connector-linked diagram nodes excluded; >6 on any slide ⇒ fail.

items.criterion_zh: 正文 ≥20 pt；图注、出处行、标题与表格文字 ≥12 pt——均按有效字号计（显式或继承字号 × 自动缩放比例）。
items.criterion_en: Body text ≥20 pt; captions, source lines, titles and table text ≥12 pt — at effective size (explicit or inherited size × autofit scale).
items.verify: checks.py cdc_layout.font_violations: run size = rPr@sz, else inherited (shape lstStyle → layout/master placeholder → master txStyles / presentation defaultTextStyle → 18 pt), × bodyPr/normAutofit@fontScale (estimated shrink when autofit stores no scale); caption/source line = text starting with Source/Fig./Credit/… or a small box (<0.6 in) carrying a source/page reference. pass/fail.

items.criterion_zh: 每个原生图表：每条可见坐标轴都有标题，数值轴标题注明单位，≥2 个系列有图例；日期类别轴的标题标明日期口径（发病日期/报告日期/确诊日期/周等）。
items.criterion_en: Every native chart: each visible axis has a title, the value-axis title states the unit, charts with ≥2 series have a legend, and a date category axis states its basis (onset / report / confirmation date, week …) in its title.
items.verify: checks.py cdc_layout.chart_axis_issues: c:valAx/c:catAx/c:dateAx c:title text unless deleted; unit token in the value-axis title; c:legend when ≥2 c:ser; date axes (dateAx or date-like category labels) need onset/report/confirm/notification/week… in the title. pass/fail.

items.criterion_zh: 静态版面：任一页均无文字溢出文本框、无形状超出页面边界、无文字相互重叠（不含带动画的形状，点击构建由 V06 判定）。
items.criterion_en: Static layout: on no slide does text overflow its box, a shape extend beyond the slide edge, or text overlap other text (shapes without animation; the click build is V06).
items.verify: checks.py cdc_layout.layout_issues: estimated text height (characters × 0.5 em per line, 1.2 line height, effective sizes, insets) > 1.25 × box height + 6 pt without autofit ⇒ overflow; box beyond the slide by >1 % ⇒ fail; estimated text areas of two text shapes/tables intersecting by >5 % of the smaller ⇒ overlap. pass/fail.

items.criterion_zh: 曲线转折（点击构建）页：任一点击状态下，已显示的注释都不与同时可见的其他文字重叠，也不遮挡图表或图片面积的 30% 以上。
items.criterion_en: Curve-turn (click-build) slide: in no click state does a revealed annotation overlap another text shape visible at the same time or cover more than 30 % of a chart or picture.
items.verify: checks.py cdc_layout.animation_occlusion on the slide with most on-click entrance effects: visibility per click group (exit effects hide), estimated text areas vs other text and chart/picture frames; no click-build slide ⇒ fail. pass/fail.

items.criterion_zh: 全篇以一致的视觉编码区分“报告数（reported）/估计或模型值/推导值”。
items.criterion_en: Consistent visual encoding distinguishes reported counts, model/estimated values and derived values.

items.criterion_zh: 英文语法、拼写、数字与单位格式正确（千分位、百分号、日期格式一致）。
items.criterion_en: English grammar, spelling, number/unit formatting correct and consistent.
items.verify: LLM 评委仅扣分 + 人工抽查

items.criterion_zh: 给出疫情规模时写明日期与口径，区分报告第 5 页 75,465 例（全国报告系统累计）与第 8/12 页 55,924 例（实验室确诊）；不把 75,465 称为实验室确诊。
items.criterion_en: Size stated with date and basis, distinguishing 75,465 (national reporting system cumulative, p5) from 55,924 laboratory-confirmed (p8/p12); 75,465 never called lab-confirmed.
items.verify: 页面/备注检索两数及其标签；answer-key T01

items.criterion_zh: [隐藏] 发现 WHO 通报序列口径变化：sitrep-24（2/13）只计实验室确诊、未计入湖北 13,332 例临床诊断，sitrep-31/35 的中国数含临床诊断；凡并列或连线这些数字，均标注口径断点或分序列，不把 46,550→74,675 读作增长。
items.criterion_en: [hidden] Notices the definitional break in the WHO sitrep series (sitrep-24 lab-confirmed only, excluding 13,332 clinically diagnosed; sitrep-31/35 include them); any juxtaposition marks the break or splits series; 46,550→74,675 not read as growth.
items.verify: answer-key T02/T03/K07；检查图表工作簿序列

items.criterion_zh: 解释“临床诊断病例”（仅湖北使用）及其在 2/20 前后被取消，依据 sitrep-24/31 原文。
items.criterion_en: Explains 'clinically diagnosed' cases (Hubei only) and their removal around 20 Feb, per sitrep-24/31.

items.criterion_zh: 按报告第 7 页给出转折时段：1/10–22 快速增长、1/23–27 达峰并平台、此后下降、2/1 报告尖峰；并与 1/23 武汉交通管制（第 15 页）在时间上对照。
items.criterion_en: Gives the turn per p7 (growth 10–22 Jan, peak/plateau 23–27 Jan, decline after, 1 Feb spike) and places it against the 23 Jan Wuhan traffic restrictions (p15).

items.criterion_zh: [隐藏] 区分按发病日期与按报告日期的曲线，并指出最近发病日因发病→确诊延迟而不完整（依据图 3 三个快照的回填或第 13 页 12→3 天）；不把发病曲线末端的下降直接当作当前传播水平。
items.criterion_en: [hidden] Distinguishes onset-date vs report-date curves and states recent onset days are incomplete due to onset→confirmation delay (Fig 3 back-fill across snapshots or p13 12→3 days); does not read the tail of the onset curve as current transmission.

items.criterion_zh: [隐藏] 3.8% 标为以 55,924 例实验室确诊为分母的粗病死率，并带出报告脚注对早期粗 CFR 偏倚的保留；不与通报中“死亡/中国总数”（含临床诊断）当作同一指标并列。
items.criterion_en: [hidden] 3.8% labelled as crude CFR over 55,924 lab-confirmed, with the report's footnote caveat on early crude CFR bias; not juxtaposed as the same metric with sitrep deaths/total (incl. clinically diagnosed).

items.criterion_zh: [隐藏] 呈现按发病时段的 CFR（17.3%→0.7%）时，说明近期发病队列随访不足（发病至死亡 2–8 周，第 14 页）和/或报告所述诊疗标准演进；不把 0.7% 当作当前真实病死风险。若简报未呈现该数值或比较，则本项通过。
items.criterion_en: [hidden] When showing CFR by onset period (17.3%→0.7%), notes incomplete follow-up of recent cohorts (onset-to-death 2–8 weeks, p14) and/or evolving standard of care; 0.7% not presented as the current true fatality risk. If the deck does not show this quantity or comparison, this item passes.

items.criterion_zh: [隐藏] 儿童 2.4% 表述为占报告病例的比例（若引用原文“attack rate”措辞，须指出该数实为病例构成比而非罹患率）；保留第 11 页“无法确定儿童感染程度”的限定。
items.criterion_en: [hidden] Children's 2.4% presented as a share of reported cases (if the source phrase 'attack rate' is quoted, the deck flags that 2.4% is a share of cases, not an attack rate); keeps the caveat that the extent of infection in children cannot be determined (p11).

items.criterion_zh: [隐藏] 78%–85% 表述为“聚集性疫情中发生在家庭的比例”（单位是聚集），不是“病例/传播的 78–85% 在家庭”；家庭续发率 3–10% 标为初步。若简报未呈现该数值或比较，则本项通过。
items.criterion_en: [hidden] 78–85% presented as share of clusters occurring in families, not of cases/transmission; household SAR 3–10% marked preliminary. If the deck does not show this quantity or comparison, this item passes.

items.criterion_zh: 严重程度构成（约 80% 轻/中、13.8% 重症、6.1% 危重）注明分母为实验室确诊，并说明“轻/中”包含肺炎。
items.criterion_en: Severity split (≈80% mild/moderate, 13.8% severe, 6.1% critical) states lab-confirmed denominator and that mild/moderate includes pneumonia.

items.criterion_zh: 医护人员感染：2,055 例实验室确诊、476 家医院、88% 来自湖北，并保留“许多可能在家庭内感染”的限定。
items.criterion_en: HCW infections: 2,055 lab-confirmed, 476 hospitals, 88% Hubei, with the household-exposure caveat.

items.criterion_zh: 潜伏期按第 12 页：平均 5–6 天，范围 1–14 天。
items.criterion_en: Incubation per p12: mean 5–6 days, range 1–14 days.

items.criterion_zh: R0 2–2.5 标为无干预情况下的值。
items.criterion_en: R0 2–2.5 labelled as in the absence of interventions.

items.criterion_zh: 引用每日新增确诊 2478→409（第 17 页）时注明两个日期（考察首末日）且为报告日计数，并引用至少一项独立佐证（发热门诊阳性率或就诊量下降）。
items.criterion_en: Cites 2478→409 daily new confirmed (p17) with both dates and as report-date counts, plus ≥1 independent corroboration (fever-clinic positivity/visits).

items.criterion_zh: 关键日期正确：1/20 纳入乙类法定报告、1/23 武汉交通管制、考察 2/16–24（或先遣 2/10 起）。
items.criterion_en: Key dates correct: 20 Jan notifiable Class B, 23 Jan Wuhan traffic restrictions, mission 16–24 Feb (advance team from 10 Feb).

items.criterion_zh: 遵守知识截止：全篇（含备注、讲稿）不出现 2020 年 2 月底以后才知道的事实（如此后的全球宣布、疫苗、后续波次或最终统计）。
items.criterion_en: Knowledge cutoff respected: no facts known only after late Feb 2020 anywhere (incl. notes/script).
items.verify: LLM 评委扣分 + 人工抽查

items.criterion_zh: 第 1 页（页面文字、图表及其工作簿、注释与备注）：每个数字/日期/比例都可追溯（材料中印有、answer-key 中出现，或在 evidence-index.csv 本页行中声明为推导/读图值），且在数值、口径或定义上都不与 answer-key 矛盾（含读图值未标注、口径混用）；出现一处即此页不通过。
items.criterion_en: Slide 1 (text, charts + workbooks, annotations, notes): every number, date or proportion is traceable (printed in the input material, in the answer key, or declared as derived / read-from-figure in an evidence-index.csv row of this slide) and none contradicts the answer key in value, basis or definition (incl. unmarked figure read-offs, mixed bases); one problem fails.

Else judge: compares slide text, notes and chart_data with the answer key and the slide's evidence-index rows (the machine trace is appended to this verify text at grading time).

items.criterion_zh: 计算粗 CFR = 2114/55,924 = 3.78% 并给出算式——嵌入工作簿活公式（值为 3.78% / 0.0378，或对 2114 与 55,924 取 ROUND 得 3.8），或在备注/证据索引中写出算式；页面显示 3.78% 或 3.8% 均可，并与报告 3.8% 对应。
items.criterion_en: Computes crude CFR 2114/55,924 = 3.78% with the formula shown — as a live embedded-workbook formula (value 3.78 % / 0.0378, or 3.8 when rounded with ROUND on 2114 and 55,924) or written out in the notes / evidence index; the slide may show 3.78% or 3.8%, matched to the reported 3.8%.
items.verify: checks.py: workbook formula value 0.0378/3.78 (±0.011 pp), or a formula evaluating to 3.8/0.038 whose inputs are 2114 and 55924, or the text '2114/55924' with 3.78% in notes/evidence-index/slides; else fail.

items.criterion_zh: [隐藏] 发现第 8 页深圳数据百分比与分母不符（2240/2842≈78.8% 而非 72%；88/2842≈3.1% 而非 2.8%），保留原印值并标为疑似印刷/计算错误，不悄悄改正、也不直接使用印错的百分比。
items.criterion_en: [hidden] Finds p8 Shenzhen percentages inconsistent with counts (2240/2842≈78.8% not 72%; 88/2842≈3.1% not 2.8%); keeps printed values and flags them, neither silently correcting nor using the wrong percentages.

items.criterion_zh: [隐藏] 若呈现康复比例：指出 18,264（24%）的分母是 75,465 全部报告病例（不是 55,924 确诊）；未呈现康复比例则本项以“无相关错误”判通过。
items.criterion_en: [hidden] If recovery share shown: identifies 24% = 18,264/75,465 all reported (not lab-confirmed); if not shown, passes only if no related error.

items.criterion_zh: 若呈现按人口的率，须正确处理通报表“人口（万人）”单位（如 2/20 湖北 104.8、广东 1.17/10 万，容差 ±0.1/±0.01），公式可复算。简报未呈现按人口的率则本项通过。
items.criterion_en: If population rates are shown, the sitrep 'population (10,000s)' unit is handled correctly (e.g. 20 Feb Hubei 104.8, Guangdong 1.17 per 100,000; tolerance ±0.1 / ±0.01) with a reproducible formula. If the deck shows no population rate, this item passes.
items.verify: checks.py: no 'per 100,000 / per 10,000' text on slides, notes or charts ⇒ pass; workbook formula 104.8 or 1.17 shown on a slide ⇒ pass; otherwise judge vs answer-key K05.

items.criterion_zh: [隐藏] 比较湖北与其他省的率时，指出湖北分子含临床诊断病例而其他省不含（sitrep-31 脚注），因此并非同口径比较。若简报未呈现该数值或比较，则本项通过。
items.criterion_en: [hidden] When comparing Hubei with other provinces, notes Hubei's numerator includes clinically diagnosed cases (sitrep-31 footnote) so the comparison is not like-for-like. If the deck does not show this quantity or comparison, this item passes.

items.criterion_zh: 计算每日新增确诊降幅 (2478−409)/2478 = 83.5%（工作簿公式值容差 ±0.1 个百分点；页面显示 83.5%、83% 或 84% 均可）。日期与“报告日计数”标注由 A14 判定。
items.criterion_en: Computes (2478−409)/2478 = 83.5% decline (workbook formula value ±0.1 pp; slide may show 83.5%, 83% or 84%). Dates and report-date labelling are scored in A14.

items.criterion_zh: 比较各地密接感染比例时使用同一口径（感染数/识别密接数），并注明四川只有百分比、无计数。若简报未呈现该数值或比较，则本项通过。
items.criterion_en: Compares contact-tracing yield across locations on one basis (infected/identified contacts), noting Sichuan gives only a percentage. If the deck does not show this quantity or comparison, this item passes.

items.criterion_zh: [隐藏] 发热门诊证据：0.14% 的分母是约 32 万“次筛查”而非人数；阳性率 0.47%→0.02% 作为与病例报告独立的下降佐证。
items.criterion_en: [hidden] Fever-clinic evidence: 0.14% is of ~320,000 screenings (not persons); positivity 0.47%→0.02% used as evidence independent of case reports.

items.criterion_zh: 所有推导量在工作簿/备注中给出源值、单位、出处页码与算式；抽查 5 个全部可复算。
items.criterion_en: All derived quantities give source values, units, page and formula; 5-item spot check reproducible.
items.verify: Judge recomputes 5 derived quantities from the embedded-workbook formulas and cell_values (evidence) and the notes.

items.criterion_zh: 没有算术错误（复算误差 ≤ 材料四舍五入精度）。
items.criterion_en: No arithmetic errors.

items.criterion_zh: [隐藏] 对州的规划结论区分可直接使用的证据（如潜伏期、家庭聚集、发病→确诊延迟、医护防护）与依赖中国情境、不能直接外推的结论（如封城规模效应、“避免数十万例”估计），各有出处。
items.criterion_en: [hidden] State planning conclusions separate directly usable evidence (incubation, household clustering, onset→confirmation delay, HCW protection) from context-bound claims not directly transferable (cordon effect, 'hundreds of thousands averted'), each sourced.

items.criterion_zh: ≥4 个原生图表（GraphicFrame 含 c:chart），至少 1 个折线、1 个柱形。
items.criterion_en: ≥4 native charts incl. ≥1 line and ≥1 column.

items.criterion_zh: PowerPoint 中每个图表 ChartData.Activate() 成功且工作簿首表 UsedRange 非空并包含所绘数值。
items.criterion_en: ChartData.Activate() succeeds for every chart; first sheet used range non-empty and contains plotted values.

items.criterion_zh: 每个嵌入工作簿列出源值、单位与出处（文件+页码）。
items.criterion_en: Each embedded workbook lists source values, units and source file+page.
items.verify: checks.py: every embedded chart workbook's strings name a source file (report/sitrep), a page and a unit word; any workbook missing one ⇒ fail, all present ⇒ pass.

items.criterion_zh: 所有推导值在嵌入工作簿中为实时公式（cell.data_type=='f'）；任一推导值为粘贴数值即否。
items.criterion_en: All derived values in embedded workbooks are live formulas; any pasted derived value fails.
items.verify: openpyxl 读取公式；对照页面推导值

items.criterion_zh: 图表所绘数值与工作簿及材料原值一致（逐点核对，允许材料自身的四舍五入）。
items.criterion_en: Plotted values match workbook and source values point by point.
items.verify: c:numCache vs 工作簿 vs answer-key

items.criterion_zh: 没有编造数据点：不插值、不补周、不把读图估计值当作报告数而不标注“读图估计”。
items.criterion_en: No fabricated points: no interpolation, no filled weeks, no unlabeled read-off-figure values presented as reported counts.
items.verify: 对照 answer-key 中材料实有数值清单

items.criterion_zh: 同一图表的一条序列内不混用不同病例类别、不同日期基准或不同快照日期；若并列则分序列并标注。
items.criterion_en: No single series mixes case classes, date bases or snapshot dates; if compared, they are separate labelled series.
items.verify: Judge from the chart_data (series names, categories) and embedded-workbook cell_values evidence (basis/class/snapshot columns).

items.criterion_zh: 曲线转折页有 ≥3 个 onPageClick 入场效果（MainSequence），各自作用于不同的可编辑形状，按逻辑顺序揭示。
items.criterion_en: Curve-turn slide has ≥3 on-click entrance effects on distinct editable shapes, revealed in logical order.
items.verify: PowerPoint COM TimeLine.MainSequence Effect.Timing.TriggerType=1 与 EffectType 入场类

items.criterion_zh: 点击构建页上，每次点击依次显示新的注释形状（至少 3 个点击步），没有任何注释在进入页面时自动出现，也没有在构建结束前被移除。
items.criterion_en: On the click-build slide each successive click reveals new annotation shape(s) — at least 3 click steps — none is revealed automatically on slide entry, and none is removed again before the build ends.
items.verify: checks.py static timing analysis of p:timing mainSeq (click groups = top-level pars with delay='indefinite'; first entrance of each target; exit effects); pass/fail. A live slideshow is not run.

items.criterion_zh: 至少一幅报告原图裁切清晰、保留图例与坐标轴，配原生可编辑标注指出与论断对应之处；整页截图不算。
items.criterion_en: ≥1 real report figure cleanly cropped with legend/axes and native annotations tied to the claim.

items.criterion_zh: slides.pdf 页数与 PPTX 一致；script.md 与备注逐页一致（归一空白后相似度 ≥0.9）。
items.criterion_en: slides.pdf page count matches; notes match script per slide (similarity ≥0.9).

items.criterion_zh: evidence-index.csv 覆盖每个承载数字的页面元素，所引页码确实包含该论断（抽查 10 行全对）。
items.criterion_en: evidence-index.csv covers every number-bearing slide element; the cited page actually contains the claim (10-row spot check all correct).

items.criterion_zh: 仅复制 .pptx 到新文件夹后重新打开无修复提示，图表 Edit Data 仍可打开（无外部链接）。
items.criterion_en: Copied alone to a new folder, reopens without repair and Edit Data still works (no external links).
items.verify: PowerPoint COM；检查 externalLink 关系

items.criterion_zh: 标明 AI 制作，且无暗示 WHO/政府机构审阅或背书的措辞或徽标。
items.criterion_en: AI-produced disclosure present; no implied WHO/government endorsement or logo.
